title: 4.5 Luis brushes his teeth
unit_title: Life at home, every day and yesterday
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, talk about the lights and machines, ask what there is, describe someone's morning in order, say what you did yesterday and on which day, ask and tell the time, say how often you do things and give dates.
goal: Say what Ana and Luis do in the morning with the he/she form and his/her (Luis brushes his teeth. / Ana gets dressed.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 4.5 Morning Routine: A1 says the routine with I (I brush my teeth.); A1+ 4.5 says it about Ana and Luis. The one new grammar relationship is the he/she form of the routine together with his or her: wakes up and gets dressed take -s, brush and wash take -es, said as one more syllable (BRUSH-iz, WASH-iz), and my becomes his or her (Ana brushes her teeth. / Luis washes his face.). Learn sets the I form against the he/she form, and Listen sets them against each other. A1 4.5's photos show the cast's Ana, and four new photos show Luis's morning, so picture banks set one person's action against the other actions and the other person. The morning is told with actions, not clock times.
prerequisite: A1 4.5 the routine with I; A1+ 1.2 he/she -s; A1 3.10 his and her.
speaking_outcome: Add a syllable to brushes and washes (BRUSH-iz, WASH-iz); keep the s of wakes and gets. Do not require native-like speed.
